items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: we have the Bobcats with Favre and Eddie Miller and with Duke and Nappy Lamar.

ctx.x: Well, that covers quite a few. I was going to ask, too. At home, you say you have a big collection, too, I imagine. Bill, I have a marvelous collection. I have thousands of them.

This is a fine picture over here that we missed. That's Louie and his Hot Five over there. Johnny St. C. and Johnny Dodds and Louie and Lil Hardin. And actually, over here, we have the Bobcats with Favre and Eddie Miller and with Duke and Nappy Lamar. A lot of New Orleans boys there.
Bill, you asked me about the Southland record.
